_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO: basic single-motor unidirectional DShot300 regression - half of the 2x2 basic matrix (1 motor x DSHOT300/600 x uni/bidirectional; see single_channel_bidirectional_300/600.json for the bidirectional half). All four channels are plain (non-bidirectional) DShot; channel 1's motor turns at throttle 100 while channels 2-4 idle - the 4-in-1 AM32 ESC only completes its arm handshake with a valid signal on all four. Nothing is read back, so this shows arming, a sustained command stream and disarm work; that the motor really turns is for the person watching (or the bidirectional pair's eRPM check).
